section_entries.label: Classical mechanics
section_entries.mathematical_role: Integrability, billiards, escape probabilities, arithmetic orbit sums, and classical trace formulae.

unit_result_entry.title: Leaky circular billiards encode totients, Möbius sums, and RH-sensitive corrections
unit_result_entry.why_material: Restricting long-lived periodic orbits forces coprimality, converts orbit sums into totient and Möbius terms, and makes nontrivial zeta zeros control the subleading escape asymptotics used to state RH-equivalent estimates.

unit_dependency_entry.context_note: The source carefully distinguishes experimental substantiation from proof.
unit_dependency_entry.representation_dependency: Equations (13)-(17) and Ramanujan's identity are essential; OCR around exponents is risky and requires scan verification for exact bounds.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Integrability, invariant tori, and billiard orbit structure
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Action-angle conservation yields invariant tori, while billiard geometry separates periodic, dense, integrable, and potentially chaotic trajectories; this establishes the structural contrast used by later trace formulas.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Periodic-orbit proliferation and the classical evolution-operator trace
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The trace of classical evolution is expressed through primitive periodic orbits and repetitions, linking a global operator spectrum to orbit geometry and motivating the classical-to-quantum bridge.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Escape corrections, response-function inversion, particle-number positivity, phase-transition thresholds, and thermodynamic regularity translate poles or zeros of zeta functions into observable or feasibility constraints.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: Experimental agreement can substantiate rather than prove RH, known zero-free regions may merely be recovered, and the strongest thermodynamic conclusion depends on an unproved physical assumption.
related_synthesis_entries.title: Analytic singularities become physical feasibility boundaries

spontaneous.spontaneous_reading: A survival constraint on billiard orbits imposes coprimality, so escape probabilities become totient and Möbius sums whose Mellin residues see zeta zeros.

directed.source_grounded_mathematics: Closed trajectories indexed by coprime m,n yield totient and Ramanujan-sum/Möbius contributions; the Mellin transform ties subleading small-hole escape terms to nontrivial zeta zeros and RH-sensitive estimates.
directed.conceptual_reading: A geometric selection rule converts an observable into arithmetic data, with asymptotic corrections carrying the difficult information.
directed.representation_or_bridge: Coprime orbit counting and Mellin transformation bridge billiard escape to zeta singularities.
directed.boundary_or_failure: Finite experiments may substantiate the asymptotics but cannot establish their limiting validity and therefore do not prove RH.
directed.uncertainty: Exponents and bounds in (13)–(17) are OCR-risky and require scan verification.

unit_result_entry.title: Arbitrary spectral realizability weakens bare Hilbert-Polya existence
unit_result_entry.why_material: An existence theorem supplies infinitely many integrable Hamiltonians for bounded sequences, including the zero sequence, but is nonconstructive; spectrum matching alone therefore does not identify a natural RH mechanism.

unit_dependency_entry.context_note: This is a source-stated limitation on treating any matching Hamiltonian as explanatory.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: GUE zero statistics are asymptotic and short-range, not complete dynamics
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Montgomery-type correlations match GUE asymptotically and suggest broken time reversal, while finite-height, long-range, and small-spacing deviations are tied to system-specific short orbits; universal statistics therefore underdetermine a Hamiltonian.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Quantum ergodicity separates universal averages from exceptional scars
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Almost-all eigenstate averages may approach the classical microcanonical value while system-specific deviations and scars remain; this qualifies random-matrix universality as a scale-limited description.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Many models reproduce the smooth zero count or even a chosen spectrum, but fluctuations, long-range correlations, boundary conditions, and naturalness determine whether the model carries explanatory RH content.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: Two-column extraction and the u04 provenance conflict require source repair; inverse-spectrum agreement alone neither excludes off-line zeros nor singles out a canonical Hamiltonian.
related_synthesis_entries.title: Smooth counts underdetermine the inverse spectral mechanism

directed.conceptual_reading: Nonuniqueness separates spectrum matching from mechanism identification.

directed.boundary_or_failure: The theorem is nonconstructive and therefore supplies neither a usable RH operator nor a proof.
directed.uncertainty: This unit reports the theorem in prose rather than reproducing its hypotheses or proof.
